$comment: Shell-owned: the last frame of the shell's one studio-events subscription for the signed-in person (docs/studio-events.md), or null before the first. The shell holds the only connection and relays each frame here, so a screen learns that something happened without a stream of its own. A signal to read again, not a log: only the newest frame is kept.

value.$comment: A StudioEvent as the channel carries it: seq, at_ms, kind, subject_type, subject_id, source, payload. The payload is whatever the publishing gear sent, so it is not described here.
